config_snapshot: Task: Add toast notification system with history panel. Requirements: Zustand store in notificationStore.ts, NotificationToast component, types: success/error/warning/info, auto-dismiss after 5s configurable, stack vertically with animations, history panel shows last 50 notifications, addNotification and clearHistory methods. Project uses Tailwind CSS, Zustand, @base-ui/react/toast (existing toastManager), React 19, TypeScript. Existing patterns: stores as flat files in src/, components with .tsx extension, CSS via Tailwind classes with custom theme variables (--color-success, --color-warning, etc.), cn() from ~/lib/utils for class merging. Toast infrastructure already exists via toastManager.add() with title/description/type/data.dismissAfterVisibleMs. Follow project conventions: no default exports, explicit imports from packages.
